en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a seafront street along high stone walls, with multi‑story buildings crowded at the edge of the cliff, a tall streetlamp in the foreground, pedestrians walking along the quay, and sailing/steam ships on calm water. Printed captions in French identify it as a souvenir from Corfu and name the street as Rue Arsène (Aux Murailles). There is handwritten ink script across the lower part of the postcard.
